title: The heterogeneous GNN design space
blurb: Per-relation messages, two-stage aggregation, type-specific layers

hook.title: Sorting the mail by sender type
hook.text: A node's mailbox now holds *different kinds of mail*: invoices, letters, parcels. A sensible clerk first **translates** each piece with a relation-specific rule, then **sorts by type and summarises each pile** (AGG within relation), and finally **combines the pile summaries** (AGG across relations), by summing or by stapling them side by side (concat). Even node types can have their own tiny MLP before and after.
hook.recall: Remember the mail clerk: message per relation, then aggregate *within* each relation, then *across* relations (e.g. concat or sum).
